# Historical API notice

Release notes and preserved documentation from the pre-sanitation 1.16 line may describe convenience entry points that returned owned storage and compiler annotations tied to that ownership model. Those files are retained for provenance only.

The current strict-C89 API is documented in `PUBLIC_API.md`, `CONTRACT_ANNOTATIONS.md`, `README_C89.md` and `MIGRATION_C89.md`.

Exact copies of the most migration-sensitive pre-sanitation documents are under `historical_docs/pre_sanitation/`.
